invariants.must_contain: Never hit-test a sprite to find a cell
invariants.why: isometric sprite bounding boxes overlap by design; hit-testing is wrong exactly at the diamond edges

invariants.must_contain: the first hit is the nearest surface
invariants.why: the walk must run top-down; bottom-up returns buried cells
substituting a nearby tile hides a tileset that was paid for and came back incomplete

invariants.must_contain: The bit order is a guess
invariants.why: AB-371 is an open assumption; presenting it as settled launders a guess into a fact
a silently missing atlas produces a runtime that loads and draws nothing
the tools are pure so edits are reversible in principle, but no stack, history or command object exists
porta and escada have documented behaviour the model cannot honour; hasEdge takes no type
what is missing must not be filled with an invented convention
